critical_code_review_comments: [financial.py L191-292] /financial/import-sheet correctly normalizes DD/MM, DD/MM/YY, DD/MM/YYYY → ISO date and strips 'UGX' / commas / spaces from amounts. Verified: '15/01/26' → '2026-01-15', 'UGX480,000' → 480000.0, '$130.50' → 130.5. Empty rows with amount<=0 are skipped (good).

[financial.py L384-419] create_sale: receipt_number generated as INV-YYYYMMDD-NNNN where NNNN = today_count+1. Race condition possible under concurrent POSTs on same day (two requests could both compute the same seq). Consider an atomic counter (db.counters.findOneAndUpdate $inc) keyed by date_tag to guarantee uniqueness. Today's safety net is `id == receipt_number` which would cause duplicate _id insert and surface the conflict, but currently no try/except — the second concurrent insert will 500. Low-impact for current single-cashier flow.

[financial.py L405] Variant-stock decrement: $inc on both 'variants.$.stock' AND main 'stock' simultaneously. Combined with PUT /products/{id} auto-recomputing stock from sum(variants.stock), this is consistent. Good.
[financial.py L424-432] /sales/drafts list filters by location_id from active_campus_id — meets 'shared + visible Parked Sales list per campus' requirement (option c).

[financial.py L467-481] /sales/by-receipt/{number} is correctly NO-auth (no Depends(get_current_user)). Only returns minimal non-sensitive fields (no created_by id, no payment_method details). Good for QR receipt verification.

[locations.py L58-87] list_locations filter logic for non-admins is correct: walks user_loc_ids, includes parents, includes non-restricted siblings under same parent. Restricted sub-locations only visible if explicitly in user.location_ids. Verified by code review only — could not test as a non-admin user (only admin creds available).

[financial.py L86-105] /financial/summary correctly excludes status in {pending, rejected} from monthly_expenses + cashflow_out and adds pending_expenses_total + pending_expenses_count. Approve flips status to 'approved' which then includes it in totals — verified end-to-end with same-day expense.
[financial.py L60-66] ProductUpdate.variants now accepted; combined with L367-368 stock recomputation logic. Verified PUT with variants persists and stock = sum(v.stock).
[financial.py L191-201] Empty rows array correctly returns 400. Default status defaults to 'pending'. Good for option (b) status-based workflow.

[Frontend] Confirmed presence of data-testids: park-sale-btn, open-parked-sales-btn, receipt-paper-size-select, sheet-import-input, sheet-import-btn. The Receipt config Select is inside the Store dialog → Settings sub-screen (one extra click).

Files >700 lines: /app/backend/routers/financial.py is 1458 lines — should be split into financial_summary.py / sales.py / products.py / sheet_import.py modules per single-responsibility. Past iterations split server.py — same hygiene needed here.
